thesis: This episode argues that major tech giants like Google, Apple, and Nvidia are re-engineering their businesses around machine learning, driving significant demand for AI workloads. It suggests that while these companies offer valuable frameworks and infrastructure, their margins and exclusivity models present a mixed outlook for investors.
